title: Gate A: box and look diff, ours against the oracle, report in parity/gate-a.json
gate: npm run gate: 27/39 on oracle-turn-1040; zero cases fails; a lower count fails unless --accept
evidence: scripts/gate.mjs + scripts/oracle/collect.mjs (one instrument both sides) + app/src/routes/gate.$state.tsx; parity/gate-a.json Box cases (task-9350f7d5eee2c573, scripts/lib/box-cases.mjs): every box of 20x20 or more outside the conversation that paints and that no named case scores. Paints means the capture shows it drawing: a background colour that is not clear, a background image, a top border that shows, a box-shadow, an img or svg, or text of its own. A paintless wrapper is no case: its box comes from what it holds. A fill or top border paints only if, laid over what is behind it (the ancestors' backgrounds on the page's own background), it moves the pixel by 4/255 or more in some channel: a perception floor, not a number from a capture. So a 0.06 white hairline on rgb(18,18,18) paints (14) and a 0.01 fill or a fill the colour already behind it does not (2, 0). Behind unknown, so not scored: the oracle's captures predate the page's background (collect.mjs page), so a box of theirs that would paint only by a fill or top border and has no opaque ancestor is laid over a colour the capture does not hold. No colour is guessed: it is no case, the box of ours it pairs with is no extra, and the gate prints it as Unscored. There are 16, in 9 states, each a page-level modal backdrop (presentation 0,0 1040x760) or dialog: oracle-connect-apps, oracle-get-mobile, oracle-new-bot-dialog, oracle-settings, oracle-settings-computer, oracle-settings-permissions and oracle-settings-updates (backdrop and dialog), oracle-picture-viewer and oracle-picture-viewer-rest (dialog). They come back when the oracle is recaptured with page. One count is lower on purpose (gate --accept, round 3 on #328): oracle-connect-apps 146 → 142. Six box cases that passed are no case now: its backdrop and dialog (behind unknown, above) and four 20x20 avatar rings under Your plugins (box:control:Your plugins › span#1-#4 at 767.7,102 to 809.7,102), each filled and top-bordered rgb(31,31,31) inside the rgb(31,31,31) dialog, so they move no pixel over what is behind them in the DOM. Known blind spot: behind means the ancestors only. The rings are stacked 14 apart, so each one's edge lies over the avatar before it, where it does show; a sibling drawn under a box is not in the model. Two cases pass that did not (box:page › header#1, box:page › div#1: page-wide pairing). Known blind spot: the capture keeps no outline, no side or bottom border, no ::before/::after and no mask, so a box drawn only by those reads as paintless and is never scored. No box is scored twice: a named element (its box and look), its own box again, a box at the place of one already kept, the transcript's time row, the conversation (its articles, its log and the boxes that hold it: transcript and card cases) and an svg's parts are left out. Each box of the oracle's pairs with one of ours anywhere on the page, one to one, best overlap first: which named element holds a box is DOM nesting, not where it is drawn, so it never scopes the pairing. The floor is any overlap at all (IoU > 0): boxes that share no point are not one box. A pair passes within 1 pt on every edge, box only (its look is a later step). An svg pairs the same way but passes on its centre alone, within 1 pt, never its size: an svg's box is its viewBox, padding and all, and the capture keeps no ink, so where its drawing ends inside the box is a known blind spot (task-992182d31333922a). A box of the oracle's with no partner fails as missing, and a painted box of ours with none fails as extra, so either reds only itself and moves no other pairing (check 'box cases'). A hover state scores only what it changed, so it has none. Recorded 2026-11-25 by a real run: 496/530 pass over 33 states, and every case that was there before has the same result.
